name: tracker-signed-sync-snapshots
goal: Match pinned Tracker HMAC wire behavior in both directions and compare standalone SQLite snapshots without exposing row values.

evidence: Pinned Tracker 2ccd8982 defines header/body signing and cursor semantics. Proof uses synthetic data and fixture requests. The comparator reports schema and table hashes/counts, including complete ops and metadata. CLI routing, deployment and live fleet access are outside this slice.
Added scoped native auth and SQLite comparator with typed hashing, integrity checks, read-only immutable copies and optional pending push fingerprints.
The two focused Vitest files failed all seven cases on checkpoint fa50ab3060 with missing module behavior and passed the same seven cases with implementation.
